name: Hopalong Attractor
desc: Barry Martin's Hopalong map iterated tens of thousands of times per frame into a log-density histogram, painting vast swirling square-ish galactic sheets and interference-like curved lattices that slowly rotate and re-weave — teal-to-amber glow on dark, plasma, blackbody ember, icy blue, or graphite pencil.

speed.doc: a,b,c drift & rotation rate (baseline drift persists at 0)

seed.doc: deterministic attractor family (a,b,c base + drift phases)
